mapper.select: INSERT INTO agent_conversation (id, owner_key, anonymous, import_id) VALUES (#{id}, #{owner}, #{anonymous}, #{importId}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING RETURNING id
SELECT id FROM agent_conversation WHERE owner_key = #{owner} AND anonymous
SELECT id FROM agent_conversation WHERE owner_key = #{owner} AND import_id = #{importId}
SELECT id, owner_key, anonymous, updated_at FROM agent_conversation WHERE id = #{id} AND owner_key = #{owner}
SELECT id FROM agent_conversation WHERE id = #{id} AND owner_key = #{owner} FOR UPDATE

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM agent_turn WHERE conversation_id = #{id} AND status < 3)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_turn (request_id, conversation_id, question, answer, status, accept_before) VALUES (#{id}, #{conversation}, #{question}, #{answer}, #{status}, #{deadline}) ON CONFLICT (request_id) DO NOTHING

UPDATE agent_conversation SET updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
